title: Are these safe for cats?
technique: The High flip camera move comes from one reference clip (@Video2, its move only); every other move is written in words.
story: A cat lady sits on her sofa at night; candles burn all over her apartment, her cat beside her.
She scrolls the Fig & Cedar product page up and down, searching. She does not buy.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: “Are these safe for cats?”
She finds nothing, gets annoyed (shown only), closes the site: “I guess we'll never know.”
The High flip turns from her down to the owner reading her sales: “I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line.” She blows out the candle.
Scout's voice: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.” End screen: “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”

shots.what: Opening shot. Wide, slow arc toward her on the sofa, candles everywhere, laptop open, the cat curled beside her.
Hard cut. Over her shoulder: her fingers scroll the product page down, then back up.
Hard cut. Close-up; the camera slowly circles her face; the cat soft behind.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Hard cut. Medium close-up, slow push in: she scrolls faster, finds nothing; jaw tightens, sharp exhale, rubs her brow.
Hard cut. Medium: she closes the site, leans back, looks at the cat.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: High flip (@Video2): the camera rises over her until it looks straight down, the sofa back sweeps the frame as the view flips, out level on the owner at her desk.
Lands from the flip. Medium close-up, slow push in: she reads Fig & Cedar at 3, the lit jar beside the laptop, and sighs.
shots.line: I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Hard cut. Close-up: she leans in and blows out the jar; three flames go out, smoke rises.
Hard cut. Macro on the smoking wicks, slow push in; the studio dims.
shots.line: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Hard cut. Scout's end screen, its picture and voice.
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
